title: Above & Beyond
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Above & Beyond”, a luxury 7-bed, 8 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 22 guests, this home offers a Private Pool, Gulf Views & Golf Cart for your exclusive enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: The Best 30A Beach House Features - Unobstructed 30A Ocean Views - 40 Yards to Beach Access - Sleeps 22, 7 Bedrooms, 10 Bathrooms - Resort Style Private Pool & Hot Tub ($70 Daily Pool Heating Fee Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Ping Pong, Putting Green & Privacy!! - 4th Floor Layout Deck & Selfie Station - 6 Adult Bikes & 6-Seater Golf Cart - 3 Living Areas, Wet Bar, Outdoor Grill - Steel & Glass Commercial Elevator - Parking for 6 Vehicles, Garage Access - Amplified WiFi on Every Floor of House 30A Beach House Vacations Welcome to Above & Beyond on 30A, the newly constructed luxurious 30A beach house rental in Seagrove, Florida that sleeps 22 people. The south side of this stunning 30A vacation rental property is located on prestigious Montgomery Street with unobstructed ocean views and the highest elevation on 30A. Easy beach access is only 40 yards away. The north side of this beach house is located directly on 30A with private parking for up to 6 vehicles. Above & Beyond truly exemplifies an upscale contemporary coastal retreat designed to easily host up to 4 families with its 7 stunning bedrooms featuring 5 King Beds and 12 Twin XL bunks. Family Friendly Fun (Sorry No Pets!) The owners of this 30A beach vacation rental created Above & Beyond from the ground up to accommodate large groups because they always had a difficult time finding a large beach house rental south of 30A with a private pool that could host all their family members at the same time. This nearly 7000 square foot beach property in Seagrove has a large private yard with landscaping and trees, private pool and layout area, and substantial guest parking. The property spans a vertical footprint of four levels featuring 7 bedrooms and a fourth-floor media room. Each of these 8 rooms has a full private bathroom with an additional two 1/2 baths for a total of 10 bathrooms to accommodate up to 22 guests comfortably. Effortless Beach Access Best of all, Above & Beyond is just a 30-second walk to the Seagrove beach access. No more parking problems. No more lugging wagons back and forth filled with chairs and coolers. No more frustrating golf cart drop-offs and pick-ups. And no more lack of bathroom access. With Above & Beyond, everything is effortless and convenient. And when your day is done at the beach, this amazing home provides a gorgeous, resort-style, negative edge pool and hot tub within a large private patio oasis complete with synthetic grass layout area, outdoor dining & grill, putting green, and ping pong table. Experience the best of both worlds. Beach. Pool. 30-seconds apart. Sleeping Arrangements for 22 (5 Kings and 12 Twin XL's) First Floor - Bunk Room - Two Twin XL over Twin XL Bunks - Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Bunk Room - Two Twin XL over Twin XL Bunks - Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom Second Floor - King Bedroom with Twin XL over Twin XL Bunk - Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Gulf Facing King Bedroom - Gulf Facing Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom Third Floor - Gulf Facing King Primary Bedroom - Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - Gulf View King Bedroom with Twin XL over Twin XL Bunk - Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Gulf Facing King Bedroom - Gulf Facing Private Bathroom, Shower Only Fourth Floor - Gulf View Media Room with Private Bathroom, Shower Only Trend Setting 30A Architecture This beautiful Seagrove beach house rental was inspired by the distinctive architecture of ocean front beach homes in Malibu and Manhattan Beach, California. Not too modern. Not too coastal. Not too traditional. Yet perfect for your next 30A beach vacation. Above & Beyond features iconic urban architectural styling that offers an unparalleled Gulf Front lifestyle along the pristine beaches of Seagrove, Florida. The house is earning a 5-star reputation as one of the best 30A beach house rentals along 30A including areas such as Seagrove, Seaside, Rosemary, Alys Beach, Watersound and Watercolor, Florida. Many architects, builders, bloggers, realtors and designers from across the country have already given fantastic positive feedback on this luxurious 30A vacation rental, and several of these influencers have requested to showcase Above & Beyond in their marketing & media. The First Floor The thoughtful floor plan of the first floor includes floor-to-ceiling windows flooding the spacious Living Room, a half Bath under the staircase, and two separate Bunk Rooms each with 4 total Twin XL's (2 over 2) plus a private bath for each Bunk Room. This configuration sleeps 4 per Bunk Room for a total of 8 sleepers on this level. Guests will enjoy luxury touches including a home sound system, upgraded Wi-Fi on every floor, TV’s in each bedroom, and sound proofing on every floor. Guests will appreciate the 2-car garage and parking for 6 vehicles. The coastal contemporary architecture of Above & Beyond begins with the two-story glass foyer featuring a stunning modern steel floating staircase with gorgeous wood treads grounding the space. The beautifully designed commercial steel and glass elevator located between the floating staircase is an added convenience for transporting beach gear, luggage, or groceries to all four floors. The Second Floor The second floor features the heart of the home with its open concept Family/Dining/Kitchen room accented by direct ocean views with floor to ceiling Euro wall sliding doors to a covered patio. The area also features a modern fireplace, a large dining room with two custom glass chandeliers, and a well-appointed kitchen paradise next to a large open pantry, coffee station and half Bath. The open chef’s kitchen features two refrigerators, a triple top gas range, gorgeous modern backsplash, two dishwashers and a large 48" sink. In addition, there is a Wet Bar with a prep sink, private laundry with sink and two washers and dryers. Sleeping space on this floor is provided in a large King bedroom with 2 total Twin XL's (bunks) and an extra large private bathroom. Another King bedroom has luxurious ocean facing views with floor to ceiling windows and a luxurious private bathroom with unobstructed ocean views from within the shower. The Third Floor On the third level, three more amazing King guest spaces await. The primary King bedroom is by far the largest in the house, and it features a King bed with direct ocean views and a Euro wall sliding door connected to a covered patio. It also has a Full bathroom with a giant wet room tub shower enclosure and private washer/dryer in the closet. The third floor also features a large King bedroom with 2 total Twin XL's (bunks) and a private bathroom with ocean views. Another King bedroom has astonishing ocean facing views with floor to ceiling windows and a breathtaking private bathroom with unobstructed ocean views from within the shower. The Fourth Floor The marvelous fourth floor is one of the largest along 30A. The crowning level of this 30A beach home is a covered patio with panoramic ocean views from Panama City Beach to Destin. The fourth floor also features a synthetic grass layout deck and rooftop selfie station with absolutely fantastic ocean views of the Gulf. The top floor has a large media room and Full bathroom that can function as a private office area if needed. And best of all, the steel and glass commercial grade elevator goes all the way up to the top floor for easy access. Go Above and Beyond With the perfect location south of 30A in Seagrove Beach, Above & Beyond 30A provides instant access to the best of 30A including shops, dining, bars, boutiques, and so much more *Fireplace is not for guest use*
